At The Law Offices of Jonathan F. Marshall, we have one of the largest and most experienced criminal defense teams in the state of New Jersey. We will explore all your options, not just push you to take a plea deal, but fight hard for a full dismissal. We understand the emotional impact going through a criminal case is difficult on you and your family, and we are known as the Criminal Justice Attorneys because we care about your rights and ability to move on from this difficult time. DUI Charge Read More An Arrest Is the Beginning, Not the End It’s understandable to feel a sense of panic when you’ve been arrested and accused of a crime. But an arrest doesn’t mean the prosecution has a strong case. With more than 250 years of legal experience defending NJ charges, our team will seize every opportunity to fight the charges against you so that the case is dismissed, a favorable plea is secured or, if that is not possible, convince a jury at trial that you should be acquitted. It may be a long road, but we will be by your side every step of the way. Our team of New Jersey criminal defense attorneys has extensive experience to help you achieve the best result in a wide range of cases. Drug Crimes Violent Crimes Weapons Offenses Sex Crimes DUI / Drunk Driving Charges Traffic Offenses Juvenile Crimes Property Crimes Theft Crimes White-Collar Crimes Federal Crimes Expungement Request Your Free Consultation Muscle & Manpower When you’re choosing a criminal defense lawyer, you should be thinking about one thing: Does this attorney have the experience and the resources to see my case through to verdict if that’s what it takes? At the Law Offices of Jonathan F. Marshall, we have selectively built a team of top-notch defense attorneys who have served as prosecutors and public defenders in more than 25 New Jersey cities and counties. Our firm has fourteen (14) offices across the state to conveniently serve our clients. The experience of those on our staff is extensive with over 250 years in practice combined, countless stories of success and many accolades, including the distinction of being certified criminal trial attorneys. We have argued thousands of cases before judges and juries in courtrooms throughout New Jersey and are ready to fight for the best outcome, perhaps even a dismissal, in your case. In fact, our lawyers have earned recognition from our peers in the legal community and are frequently invited by the media to speak as legal consultants. DUI / DWI Lawyer & Other Legal Services A DUI (driving under the influence) or DWI (driving while intoxicated) charge in New Jersey can cost you hundreds of dollars in fines, up to 30 days in jail, loss of driving privileges for 90 days, and additional, lasting financial consequences. As highly experienced and specialized DWI attorneys in New Jersey, we can represent you with any sort of drunk driving offense you might be facing and seek the best possible results in your case. Not only do we handle DUI cases but we can also assist with traffic offenses, drug charges, assault offenses, theft offenses, sex crimes, gun & weapon offenses, federal charges and more.
